messages:
mira: Quick heads-up — after yesterday's kernel handoff rollout we saw a ~3x increase in 99p queue_wait_ms for streaming requests with long prefixes in us-west-2. KV cache hit-rate dropped ~12% for those flows. :eyes:
alex: Do you have a span / profile? which kernel variant rolled?
sam: Can you also pull token-level latency breakdowns? our dashboards only show per-model avg token latency right now.
mira: rolled v3-kern-compact -> v3-kern-opt2 at 23:10 UTC. Perf bench numbers looked fine, but live traffic shows longer prefix decoding paths + more KV cache misses. I ran a quick profile and see extra memcopies in the handoff path.
alex: Any sign the scheduler changed batching heuristics or just kernel choice?
mira: batching depth stayed similar, but queue wait jumped. suspect the new kernel disables prefix-KV coalescing (or changes cache admission), so more KV lookups per request.
cheng: If prefix coalescing is off we can get extra IO + cache churn which would explain the 99p spike. We need token-level telemetry: split token latency into decode/kernel/io/queue_wait.
sam: Yep — proposed PromQLs to get started (ran locally):
```
sum by(route, le) (rate(token_latency_bucket[5m]))
# then histogram_quantile(0.99, ... ) per route

# kv cache hit rate for streaming routes
sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{route=~"stream-.*"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups_total{route=~"stream-.*"}[5m]))
```
alex: Good. Also capture batch size histogram and scheduler efficiency (served_tokens / allocated_tokens) over time. We need per-route KPIs: p50/p90/p99 token latency + kv_cache_hit.
mira: Proposed dashboard changes:
- Token-level stacked breakdown panel (decode | kernel_exec | io | queue_wait)
- Per-route KPI table (p50/p90/p99 token latency, kv_cache_hit_rate, batch_size_p50)
- Continuous batching panel: batch_size_histogram (buckets 1..64), queue_wait_p50/p95 time series
- Alert: if 99p queue_wait > 200ms for streaming routes for 5m -> paging
sam: I'll open a small PR adding the panels + queries and an alert rule.
perf-bot: PR created by @sam: https://git.internal/r/repo/PR/5234 :package::rocket:
mira: Uploaded a profiler snapshot to the perf bucket and a short runtime log sample from the spike: 
```
[2026-03-15T23:11:03Z] route=stream-chat user=svc-abc kernel=v3-kern-opt2 prefix_kv_hits=3 prefix_kv_lookups=27 queue_wait_ms=312 token_exec_ms=2.1
```
alex: That log line matches — high queue_wait with many prefix lookups. Next steps: (1) roll back v3-kern-opt2 on canary, (2) run microbench focused on prefix coalescing with matching batch distributions, (3) land dashboard + alert.
sam: I'll trigger the rollback and link the revert PR here. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollback triggered: deploy/rollout/1745 :white_check_mark:
mira: After rollback, hit-rate climbed back and 99p queue_wait returned to baseline within ~8 minutes. I'll post the before/after charts in #eng-runtime. If rollback is green, let's schedule a follow-up to test a kernel patch that preserves coalescing heuristics. cc @cheng
alex: Thanks — keep notes here. We'll review the microbench results before re-rolling any kernel changes. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
